_comment: Sources crawled on every run. Adding a source = adding a line here (great first PR). `feeds` are RSS/Atom. `pages` are for labs without a feed: the crawler reads the news index and opens article links under `articlePath`. URLs are best-effort; fix them as sites move.
_exclude: `exclude` lists slugs under `articlePath` that are category pages, not articles.
_considered: Checked and not crawled (2026-10): ElevenLabs, Luma (/news), Synthesia, Recraft, Higgsfield, LTX Studio, Captions and Hedra blogs are mostly SEO guides, which would count as news; Runway /news, Physical Intelligence, Decart, 1X, Skild, MiniMax, Kling, Krea, Ideogram, Odyssey render in JavaScript, rate-limit or list no articles. Their posts still arrive through Hacker News and are filed under the company (LAB_HOSTS in src/lib/taxonomy.ts).
_blocked: Hosts whose stories must never be stored, e.g. after a publisher asks to be removed. The next run deletes their existing stories too.
